author: jwow1
quote:
I really wanted to like this game but I just couldnt. Obviously the graphics are phenomenal and probably should earn this a 5  out of ten just because of them BUT being locked at 30 fps destroys the emersion.  Nothing is clear while in motion and even with a ps5 pro im getting frame skips during large action scenes. So its pretty but only if you stand still.

The gameplay is atrocious.  It is Hella buggy for a game that spent 13 years in production. The storyline terrible, I dont think I laughed out loud a single time and never cared about the characters.  I almost quit after several hours of playing in the beginning because it was such a terrible flow but I kept pushing hoping it gets better.  It does but not by much and the ending just left me annoyed that I wasted so many hours. 

The real reason this gets a 0 though is how handicapped you are in the game. And what I mean by that is this is GRAND THEFT AUTO. The amount of times I tried reliving my childhood by stealing cars, shooting everyone and just causing as much chaos as possible and I wasnt able to because of some random reason really was a disappointment. 

Lets not get started with the fact they will have. Amonth subscription to an offline game...

If I could get a refund I would.
